fullData.title: Starry Night Counting Journey
fullData.description: Count shiny stars in the night sky to practice numbers from eleven to twenty in the correct order.

challenges.instruction: Can you touch and count all the glowing stars in the circle?
challenges.hint: Try tapping each star one by one as you count them in order.
challenges.narration: Look at these bright stars arranged in a ring. Let us touch and count every single one!

challenges.instruction: Let us count the stars lined up neatly in a row!
challenges.hint: Start from the left end and tap each star as you go along the line.
challenges.narration: Here they are in a straight row. Point to each star and count carefully.

challenges.instruction: Can you find and count all these scattered stars?
challenges.hint: Take your time and tap each star so you do not miss any.
challenges.narration: These stars are sprinkled all over the sky. Count them one by one!

challenges.instruction: Count the stars in these little groups together!
challenges.hint: Count the stars in the first group, then keep going to the next.
challenges.narration: The stars are gathered in cozy little clusters. Let us count them all up.

challenges.instruction: Here is another lovely line of twinkling stars to count.
challenges.hint: Remember to touch every star once as you count along.
challenges.narration: Keep up the wonderful counting! Let us see how many stars are in this long line.

challenges.instruction: Can you count these scattered stars shining bright?
challenges.hint: Tap slowly and watch the numbers appear on each star.
challenges.narration: We are getting closer to the end of our starry path. Count each star carefully!

challenges.instruction: Our final challenge! Count every single star on the board.
challenges.hint: You can do it! Count all the way to the very last star.
challenges.narration: This is our biggest star circle yet. Count them all to finish your journey!
